يبتغون (form VIII)
# يَبْتَغُونَ (yabtaḡūna) /jab.ta.ɣuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَغَى (ibtaḡā)
# يُبْتَغَوْنَ (yubtaḡawna) /jub.ta.ɣaw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَغَى (ibtaḡā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
